title: Malai Ladu
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Cheeni (Sugar) powdered ½ Cup or to taste

steps.instruction: In bowl,add khoya and mix well until smooth & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein khoya dal dein aur smooth hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In non-stick wok,add cream and cook on low flame for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Non-stick karhai mein cream dal dein aur halki ancch per 2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add khoya and cook on low flame for 15 minutes or until it leave the sides of the wok and mix well continuously.
steps.romanUrdu: Khoya dal dein aur halki ancch per 15 minutes ya karhai ki sides chornay tak paka lein aur musalsal mix kertay rahein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder,sugar and mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder aur cheeni dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cashew nuts,pistachio and give it a good mix & refrigerate for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Kaju aur pista dal ker mix karein aur 15 minutes kliya refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease hands with oil,take a mixture make ladu of equal sizes.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur mixture ko la ker ek jaisay sizes ka ladu tayyar ker lein.
Pista sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: Here you go Malai Ladoo recipe for your sweet cravings. Just like what you buy from the halwai. #HappyCookingToYou
